events.title: Djuren i vår värld - en utställning med Vaavaskonst
events.description:
Välkommen till Djuren i vår värld, en utställning med mina djurmålningar!

Jag heter Devika och skapar konst under namnet Vaavaskonst. Jag målar djur och natur med färg, värme och personlighet. Genom min konst vill jag lyfta fram djur som individer med egna känslor, personligheter och berättelser.

För mig är konsten ett sätt att uttrycka min kärlek till djuren och utforska vår relation till dem. Jag hoppas att mina målningar kan väcka nyfikenhet, skapa igenkänning och få oss att se djuren omkring oss med nya ögon.

Varmt välkommen att ta del av min konst och upptäcka djuren i vår värld!

events.title: Anna Bjerger – Gallery Weekend Stockholm
events.description:
Vernissage i samband med Gallery Weekend Stockholm
Fredag 6 november kl. 17–19
Opening in connection with Gallery Weekend Stockholm
Friday November 6, 5–7 pm
 
(Scroll down for English text)
 
Vi har glädjen att bjuda in till en mindre presentation med Anna Bjerger i galleriets inre rum. I Comma visas ett antal målningar som är utförda under de senaste månaderna.

I arbetet med dessa verk har jag samlat in motiv likt dagboksanteckningar. Ljuset, formen och associationerna är det som främst styr mina val men också intuition och tvivel. I målningarna finns en inneboende kronologi, förflyttning samt tid. Det som är både personligt och allmänt ryms vilket skapar förtrolighet och samtidigt distans. Ett motsatsförhållande vilket även speglas i min måleriska process. 
– Anna Bjerger
 
Anna Bjerger, f.1973 i Skallsjö, bor och arbetar i Småland och Malmö. Hon är utbildad på S:t Martins School of Art and Design (1994–1997) och Royal College of Art i London (1999–2001) och har därefter visats regelbundet på gallerier och institutioner i Sverige och internationellt. Hennes senaste utställning på Galleri Magnus Karlsson var Home Encyclopedia (2025). Bjerger är representerad i samlingarna på bl.a. Moderna Museet, Stockholm, Louisiana Museum of Modern Art, Danmark, SMK Statens Museum for Kunst, Danmark, Sveriges Riksdag, Stockholm och Stedelijk Museum, Amsterdam, Nederländerna samt i mängder av privata och publika samlingar över hela världen.
 
Öppettider under helgen
Fredag 6.11, 12–19
Lördag 7.11, 12–18
Söndag 8.11, 12–16
 
Anna Bjerger visar utställningen lördag 7 november kl. 13.00
Läs mer om programmet för Gallery Weekend Stockholm här
Alejandro Sinturas utställning visas i galleriets stora rum.
Välkomna!
 
--
 
We are pleased to invite you to a small presentation by Anna Bjerger in the inner room of the gallery. Comma features a number of paintings created over the past few months.
 
When working on these paintings, I have gathered motifs much like diary entries. Light, shapes, and associations are the main factors guiding my choices, but also intuition and doubt. There is an inherent chronology, movement and sense of time within the paintings. They encompass both the personal and the universal, creating a sense of intimacy whilst maintaining a certain distance. This contrast is also reflected in my painting process.
–Anna Bjerger
 
Anna Bjerger, born in 1973 in Skallsjö, lives and works in Småland and Malmö. She was educated at St Martin’s School of Art and Design (1994–1997) and the Royal College of Art in London (1999–2001), and has since exhibited regularly at galleries and institutions in Sweden and internationally. Her most recent exhibition at Galleri Magnus Karlsson was Home Encyclopedia (2025). Bjerger’s work is represented in the collections of, amongst others, Moderna Museet, Stockholm; the Louisiana Museum of Modern Art, Denmark; SMK Statens Museum for Kunst, Denmark; the Swedish Parliament, Stockholm; and the Stedelijk Museum, Amsterdam, the Netherlands, as well as in numerous private and public collections worldwide.
 
Opening hours during Gallery Weekend Stockholm:
Friday, November 6, 12:00–7:00 pm
Saturday, November 7, 12:00–6:00 pm
Sunday, November 8, 12:00–4:00 pm
 
Anna Bjerger will give a tour of the exhibition on Saturday, November 7, at 1:00 pm

I Sverige har Mastercard-användare tillgång till förköpsbiljetter från 18/2 kl. 09.00 t.o.m. 20/2 kl. 08.00. Besök www.priceless.com/music för mer information.

events.title: The Trials
events.description: What is justice after the Holocaust? The trials after the Holocaust have served multiple purposes. Beyond establishing individual responsibility, they have helped shape legal precedent and historical narratives. As a result, new laws and legal practices emerged. In this exhibition, you will explore the many hundreds of cases brought after the Holocaust and gain an understanding of how both the Holocaust itself and the efforts to address Nazi crimes have shaped our present.

events.title: Robert and Barbro Nilsson - Life in color and form
events.description: Robert Nilsson, sculptor, and Barbro Nilsson, textile artist and artistic director of AB Märta Måås-Fjetterström's weaving studio, were a creative couple who left a strong mark on 20th-century Swedish sculpture and textile art. The exhibition features works from the couple's oeuvre—including textiles, sculpture, and painting - alongside sketches, models, and archival material. The exhibition is a collaboration with Blå Hallen, Höganäs, with guest curators Xi Wallén Keller and Martin Enget.

events.title: The Viking World – the world’s largest Viking exhibition
events.description: The myth of the violent, plundering Vikings (with horned helmets) has been circulating for a long time. But what do we really know about life in Nordic countries one thousand years ago?

events.title: Dala Horse Painting Workshop
events.description: Unleash your creativity in Stockholm’s historic Gamla Stan! Join an authentic workshop and paint your very own Swedish Dala horse (dalahäst). Guided by local experts, you’ll learn about the history of this iconic symbol and try traditional kurbits patterns or your own unique design. All materials are included, and no prior experience is needed. Take home a unique, handcrafted souvenir from your time in Sweden! Perfect for families, couples, and groups.

events.title: Susanne Nilsson – Wings of Silence – Ceramic Art
events.description: They came flying without moving a wing, sat down without landing – and now they refuse to move – which seems perfectly fine to them. No two are alike – beak, expression and attitude, everything is their own invention. Come and meet them: our most common birds, seen with a twinkle in their eye.

events.title: Flatenbastun – Lakeside Sauna Experience
events.description: Flatenbastun offers a relaxed lakeside sauna experience by Lake Flaten in southern Stockholm. Here, warmth, nature and refreshing swims come together in a social and welcoming setting for both regulars and first-time guests. Open sauna sessions are available year-round and booked in advance via the website. Bring swimwear and towels for a genuine Swedish sauna experience close to nature.

venue.name: Flatenbastun
venue.district: Nearest bus stop: Flatenbadet (SL bus stop)

events.title: AW Create
events.description: A relaxing moment with bubbly, snacks, and stress-free crafting. Bring your colleagues, friends – or come by yourself and hang out in a warm, creative environment on Södermalm in Stockholm. We set out all the materials and inspiring seasonal ideas. Follow clear step-by-step instructions or create completely freely – the choice is yours. This is all about the joy of creating, good company, and easing gently into the weekend. For groups of 4 people or more, you can book other time slots.

events.title: Nocturne: Maria Sjödin at Haymarket
events.description: Craftsmanship meets avant-garde sensibility in Maria Sjödin Stockholm's exhibition at Haymarket. In Nocturne, Maria presents a series of sculptural art pieces in black and red. Distressed silk, frayed edges, raw surfaces and torn silk meet couture precision, creating silhouettes that move between dark sensuality and drama. The works explore the tension between structure and motion, while framing the contrast between elegance and rawness. On view in Gretas at Haymarket until January.

events.title: Södermalms Full English Comedy Nights
events.description: Every Thursday, ComedyNation the best boutique comedy club proudly present Full English Standup Comedy, a tradition in Södermalm, Stockholm. This two-hour show offers a distinctive blend of comedy styles, showcasing local and English-speaking comedians who bring a variety of tastes and humor to the stage. To fully enjoy the evening, we recommend arriving by 18:00 to savor a meal and drinks at the Mariatorget Pitchers’ casino bar. 18+, door 18:00, show 19:00, limited number of seats.

events.title: Blowing Figures into Space
events.description: Blowing Figures into Space by the sculptor Davide Rivalta is a large-scale outdoor exhibition. It comprises twelve animal sculptures in bronze and aluminum, installed in symbolic locations, creating new perspectives on nature, power and coexistence. The sculptures are placed directly on the ground making them appear as if they have reclaimed the urban environment. Through this approach, Rivalta makes art accessible in public spaces and promotes dialogue across cultures. Guided tours each month.

events.title: Shiso Kanakuri – The Japanese Athlete Who Did NOT Disappear
events.description: In his home country of Japan, Shiso Kanakuri is a legend. In Sweden, he is best known as the central figure in the constructed story of "the Japanese athlete who disappeared" during the marathon at the 1912 Olympic Games in Stockholm.

events.title: Hatt Couture - Royal Hat Fashion at the Royal Armoury.
events.description: Hatt Couture is an exhibition about an imaginative accessory—the hat—worn by Swedish royals from the mid-20th century, the golden age of hats, to the 2000s.

events.title: Stockholm International Film Festival 2026
events.description: Whether you want to be moved, surprised, inspired, or simply escape into another world for a while, the Stockholm International Film Festival is the place to be. The program features everything from glamorous Red-Carpet screenings, gala premieres, and award-winning festival favorites to Face2Face conversations with directors and actors. It’s not just about watching films. It’s about truly experiencing them together.

events.title: Standup – Guldgruvan
events.description: Guldgruvan Standup Club hosts stand-up shows focusing on darker, more alternative, and less mainstream stand-up comedy.

events.title: The Wonder of Colours – Gothenburg Colourism in a New Light
events.description: Step into a world of vivid colour, where brushstrokes pulse with rhythm, emotion, and life. This extensive presentation introduces us to the beloved Gothenburg Colourists – from Ivan Ivarson, Ragnar Sandberg and Inge Schiöler to Åke Göransson and Märta Taube-Ivarson – alongside both their forerunners and followers. Visitors will encounter both iconic masterpieces and rarely shown works. The exhibition has been produced in collaboration with the Gothenburg Museum of Art.

events.title: Lake Sauna by Mälaren at Kaggeholm Castle
events.description: Experience open sauna sessions in a lakeside sauna at Kaggeholm Castle on Ekerö. A booking covers one spot in the shared sauna. Mälaren sits directly outside for anyone wanting to plunge between rounds. Suits regulars and first timers alike. Bring swimwear and a towel.

events.title: What happened after that? - Puppet theater at Junibacken!
events.description: A puppet show based on "The book about Moomin, Mumble and Little My" (1952) by Tove Jansson. The theater is performed in the exhibition “Midwinter in Moominvalley” in Swedish.

events.title: Yokai
events.description: Yokai are Japanese supernatural creatures - loved and feared part of popular culture for hundreds of years. From the scroll paintings, woodcuts, and books of the Edo period (1603–1868) to today's video games, films, and manga.

events.title: Södermalm's Swedish Stand-up Comedy
events.description: Need a break from your everyday routine and a good laugh? We've gathered some of the best comedians for a night of unforgettable jokes and sharp observations. Our carefully curated comedy show is back, better than ever, with ticket options to suit every budget. We recommend arriving from 18:00 if you'd like to enjoy food and drinks before the show. Age limit: 18+. Doors open at 18:00. Show starts at 19:00.

events.title: Ghost Hunt in Gamla Stan
events.description: Ghost Hunt in Gamla Stan is an exciting, educational, and interactive city adventure where your smartphone guides you through Stockholm’s oldest quarters. As you discover fascinating history, real historical events, and dark legends, your team navigates narrow cobblestone alleys to solve clever riddles and uncover the city’s hidden secrets.

events.title: Guided Tour in the Historical Food Hall Östermalms Saluhall
events.description: Newly renovated and more beautiful than ever. Östermalm's Saluhall re-opened its doors in 2020 after an extensive renovation. Book a guided tour in one of Stockholm's most beloved buildings. Your host is Lina Bielsten, founder of Östermalm's Saluhall Magasin (2010-2023). Lina presents the 135-year history of the market hall and architectural details, mixed with funny anecdotes from famous guests. A behind-the-scenes tour in which food samples can be added. Tours can be booked on request.

events.title: The Vasa Walk
events.description: A free interactive audio walk that takes you to the actual places where the famous Vasa ship’s short history unfolded. The walk starts outside the Vasa Museum, continues through the Djurgården area and ends on the Beckholmen island. Hear about Vasa’s sinking in 1628, the salvage in 1961, and the work to preserve & display the ship. Sound, music & visual elements bring the places to life. Guide: Fred Hocker, Director of Research, the Vasa Museum. The Vasa Walk is part of the Support Vasa project.

events.title: A World of Tales
events.description: Join us on a journey to the land of imagination in the exhibition A World of Tales. Here, children and their grown-ups can listen to stories from around the globe – myths, legends, creation tales, and fairy tales. Admission is free for everyone under 19.

events.title: True Crime – Old Town
events.description: Hear about murders, executioners, and punishments in the city’s dark history. The murder of Axel von Fersen, guillotinings, and Anckarström’s path to his punishment. Pass through prison gates, visit Bödelns gränd, hear about fencing duels and monastery dagger murders.

events.title: The Metro - in step with the times
events.description: The Metro is much more than just a way of transportation, it is also an arena and an expression of society’s values, history and social dynamics. Welcome to the amazing world of the Metro and an exhibition that tells the story of the Stockholm Metro as a way of transportation and as a cultural phenomenon.

events.title: Ndidi Dike – Rare Earth Rare Justice
events.description: Färgfabriken is proud to present an exhibition by British-Nigerian artist Ndidi Dike. Rare Earth Rare Justice addresses questions of extraction and postcolonial structures while offering a powerful visual experience in Färgfabriken’s Main Hall.

events.title: MESSIAH
events.description: In MESSIAH, the artist Clara Ianni explores the consequences of oil extraction through religious allegories of the Savior, the Resurrection, and the Apocalypse. Through powerful soundscapes featuring human voices, video animations based on seismic data, and photogravures, she renders invisible industrial processes both audible and visible.

events.title: Big Ben Stand Up Every Day 8 PM
events.description: Are you ready to laugh until the tears flow? Don't miss the chance to participate in BigBenStandUp & StandUpSverige's daily stand-up performances that promise to brighten your evening! Every day at 20.00, some of Sweden's most talented comedians take the stage to treat you to an evening filled with hysterically funny entertainment and unforgettable moments.

events.title: Kyle Alessandro
events.description: Konserten arrangeras av FKP Scorpio Kyle Alessandro kommer till Debaser Nova med ”AURA” – hans mest profilerade albumsläpp hittills och starten på ett nytt internationellt kapitel. Den norska artisten rör sig mellan modern pop, stark känslomässig närvaro och ett mer filmiskt uttryck. Under det senaste året har han gått från att skriva låtar i sitt sovrum till att stå på Eurovision-scenen, och nu tar han nästa steg med sin första egna Europaturné. För den som möter Kyle Alessandro för första gången är det här inte bara en chans att upptäcka en ny popartist tidigt i karriären, utan att kliva in i ett universum som redan har börjat samla en internationell publik. På ”AURA” utforskar han identitet, tvivel, relationer och vägen mot klarhet i kaoset – med låtar som ”Rosary”, ”Backseat” och ”Halo” som bär både intimitet och storslagenhet. Live vill Kyle Alessandro göra musiken till något mer än en framförd låtlista. Konserten bygger vidare på albumets emotionella och visuella värld, men med den närhet och oförutsägbarhet som bara uppstår i rummet. Den 12 november kommer han till Debaser Nova i Stockholm för en kväll där ett nytt nordiskt popnamn tar plats på egen hand. Åldersgräns: 18 år 13 år i målsmans sällskap

events.title: The joyful world of Stig Lindberg
events.description: In the summer of 2026, the Porcelain Museum in Gustavsberg will open an exhibition about Stig Lindberg – one of Sweden's most beloved and versatile designers. Marking the 110th anniversary of his birth, you are invited into a colorful and playful world of design.

events.title: STROLLER THURSDAY
events.description: On parental leave with a baby and looking for something fun to do with other adults? Every Thursday between 12:00 and 15:00, Paradox Museum Stockholm offers 25% off adult admission for parents on parental leave with babies. Bring your stroller and explore a world filled with over 70 interactive illusions, unexpected perspectives, and fun photo opportunities. A different kind of activity during parental leave, where the grown-ups get to have some fun too! Limited availability!

events.title: Éva Mag: stories without beginnings
events.description: In the art gallery’s main hall, Mag creates an installation that takes up the entire space. The surface is transformed into a landscape of welded metal and fired and unfired clay, where uprooted trees, vessels, and thorny branches spread out across the room. The landscape oscillates between decay and survival, exploring the vitality of the materials. They bear traces of the turbulent times we live in and of humanity’s persistent attempts to find balance, stay upright, and carry on.

events.title: Iconic Collaborations
events.description: Iconic Collaborations at Sven-Harry’s Art Museum presents a groundbreaking exhibition, bringing together—for the first time—the designer collections created for H&M. The show highlights some of the most distinguished names in fashion, such as Karl Lagerfeld, Stella McCartney, Maison Martin Margiela, Kenzo, and Sonia Rykiel.

events.title: Evening tour along quays and Skeppsholmen
events.description: Enjoy an evening walk through central Stockholm along waterfronts, parks and historic quays. Passing landmarks such as the Royal Dramatic Theatre, the National Museum, the Royal Palace and the Opera, you will discover the city's history, architecture and maritime heritage, including beautiful Skeppsholmen. The tour ends in Kungsträdgården, close to restaurants and cafés.

events.title: Pottery Painting in Stockholm
events.description: Express your creativity by painting pre-made pottery pieces from a wide range of designs. Whether it’s a fun kids’ activity, a special celebration, or some well-deserved me time, our 2-hour pottery painting sessions are perfect for all ages and skill levels.

events.title: Absolut Absolut
events.description: Step into the story of Absolut Vodka, the Swedish brand that became a global icon through groundbreaking marketing. It’s a story of nostalgia, courage, creativity, and innovation, told through advertisements, bottles, art, and cocktails. The exhibition also features a cocktail machine where you can try classic drinks.

events.title: Postis!
events.description: With almost 400 objects in the postal history exhibition, POST welcomes visitors to an experiential and interactive exhibition that activates all the senses. Here you can follow the history of the post office from the 17th century until today. The exhibition highlights the hard work and both the people who made communication between people possible over five centuries and those who received mail. An exhibition for both adults and children.

events.title: Soul, jazz and a touch of Christmas with Cilla Ribbing Band
events.description: Enjoy a vibrant evening of music, rhythm and joy at beautiful 18th-century Kristinehov Manor in Södermalm, Stockholm! In the second set, the band welcomes the Christmas season with beloved American Christmas classics in soulful and jazzy arrangements. Coffee/tea and cookies included.

events.title: Open sauna and cold plunge in Riddersvik
events.description: Experience open sauna sessions by Mälaren in Hässelby, where the old orchard park slopes down to the water. Each session is open to anyone and a spot is booked in advance. Between rounds the jetty is a few steps across the grass. Sessions run year round, with the sharpest contrast in the winter months. Bring swimwear and a towel.

events.title: Reality (in Swedish)
events.description: In Reality, the audience follows the filming of a feature film, and may even become part of the movie as extras. Using technology and AI, the room transforms into various environments, from a cottage in Hälsingland to a spaceship. The performance explores what makes life real and our longing to truly feel alive.

events.title: Like share hate – An Exhibition on Antisemitism
events.description: How is our society affected by antisemitism and other forms of racism? And what can we do to stop it? In this exhibition, you will learn more about how to decode antisemitic messages and how your social media-feed is influenced by your behavior. You will also meet people who have been subjected to hate, both online and in real life. And you’ll get advice on how we can work against hatred.

events.title: Thursday evenings at Nationalmuseum
events.description: Kickstart the weekend at Nationalmuseum! On Thursday evenings, the museum is abuzz with people, art and music, with free admission for everyone from 5pm to 8pm. Enjoy an ever-changing programme of afterwork drinks, music, workshops and other activities. Every Thursday from 17:00 to 20:00, 3 September–17 December

events.title: Pairing is Caring: Cocktail Edition
events.description: Take a seat at the bar and immerse yourself in the flavours, stories, and creativity behind one of Downtown Camper's signature cocktails. Watch as our bartenders bring the drink to life, sharing the techniques and inspiration that make it unique. From the first sip to the final flourish, you'll gain a new appreciation for the art of cocktail making. Join us in The Nest, our cocktail lounge on floor 9, for a relaxed yet unforgettable tasting experience. 18+ age limit.

events.title: Clann Mhic Ruairí
events.description: Vocal tradition from northwestern Ireland Since 2013 Clann Mhic Ruairí has established itself as one of the truly major names on the Irish folk music scene. The last time the group played at Stallet, their concert was broadcast on Sveriges Radio's Folkmusiken i P2. Their two albums have been praised by Irish music critics. Clann Mhic Ruairí has also appeared on Irish television on several occasions and performed at festivals and concert venues in numerous countries.

events.title: Ylva Snöfrid, The House of the Muses
events.description: The House of the Muses is Snöfrid’s largest exhibition to date and spans four hundred paintings, thousands of drawings, and specially crafted objects. In 13 halls, you can encounter the nine muses and the four elements, and engage in 34 rituals where installations and paintings are brought into use.

events.title: The Economy Lab
events.description: The Economy Lab is a good place for parents and children to explore economics together. The Economy Lab is about everyday economics and how money functions in daily life. What do you think our tax money should be spent on? How can you influence the climate through what you buy? And what's really the best way to save money?

events.title: Exhibition at NK Art Bakery - Erdem Bilgin
events.description: 6  paintings are on display at NK Art Bakery until December 24th. Erdem Bilgin's first exhibition. Have fika and see the paintings or just stop by and have a look while passing by.

events.title: Slussen, Old Djurgårdsstaden & the Vasa Museum
events.description: From Slussen to Djurgården, discover Stockholm's maritime history and urban development. The walk begins where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic Sea and continues to the historic wooden houses of Djurgårdsstaden. The tour ends with admission and a guided visit to the Vasa Museum, home to the famous warship that sank in 1628 and was salvaged more than 300 years later.

events.title: Södermalm's heights - city walk with a view
events.description: Join on a walk through Södermalm's historic heights, from Slussen to Medborgarplatsen. Strolling along Glasbruksgatan, Fiskargatan and Mosebacke, enjoy beautiful views and discover stories of people, places and transformation. Learn how Södermalm evolved from a working-class district into one of Stockholm's most creative and vibrant neighbourhoods.

events.title: Daily Stockholm bike tour
events.description: Experience Stockholm in a different way, on a comfortable bike with spectacular views. We pass the most iconic areas at a relaxed pace and take a nice break in the middle of the tour. This experience is for people from all over the world and also for 'Stockholmers'. A special Swedish-Dutch history tour is also offered. Tours are given at 9.30 and 13.30 every day.

events.title: Thursday After Work Drinks
events.description: Stockholm is a great place to meet new people when we actually take initiative. This is for everyone who wants to make friends with expats and locals! More than 60 people join us in Old Town every other Thursday, a nice mix of regulars and newcomers. If any questions pop up, please reach out on Instagram or meetstockholm.org. You're most welcome to Meet Stockholm 🙌Stockholm is a great place to meet new people when we actually take initiative. This is for everyone who wants to make friends with expats and locals! More than 60 people join us in Old Town every other Thursday, a nice mix of regulars and newcomers. If any questions pop up, please reach out on Instagram or meetstockholm.org. You're most welcome to Meet Stockholm

events.title: Colour! An exhibition for children and curious grown-ups
events.description: Note: The exhibition is open on weekends and school holidays.Become a colour explorer! Put on a lab coat, slip on a pair of color goggles, and step through the colour portal. Experience and explore colour in different ways in the exhibition’s vibrant and immersive rooms. Colour! is a sensory and playful exhibition aimed at children aged 6–12 and their curious adults.

events.title: Jazz Fusion Thursday at The Node
events.description: The Node house band Trio Van Funk plays jazz fusion every Thursday from 4–7 pm at The Node, beneath the Sergel Fountain in central Stockholm.

events.title: Clown and Le jeu workshop
events.description: Theatre workshop to discover the grammar of theatre: Games, pleasure, impulse, complicite, humour, fixed point, beauty, lightness. Second part of the workshop i clown. We discover through improvisations what is funny about ourselves in order to make the audience laughing at this lovable, open and naive red nosed person who pops up on the stage when we least expect it.

events.title: Cosmonova: Fungi
events.description: Much of life on Earth is interconnected by a hidden network that we are only just beginning to understand. Out of sight, between the worlds of plants and animals, another world exists – the kingdom of fungi. Join us on a journey from the ancient Tarkine rainforest of Tasmania to the mysterious wilderness of China’s Yunnan Province, in search of solutions to some of our planet’s greatest challenges. The film is approximately 40 minutes long and is shown in its original English-language version.

events.title: Who Owns the Stockholm Night?
events.description: Who should decide the future of the night life: the neighbors, the venue owners, or the politicians? A warm welcome to a fantastic evening hosted by 08 and Kulturhuset Hartwig! Join us for an after-work and a lively debate featuring Nike Örbrink (Christian Democrats), Maria-Elsa Salvo (Social Democrats), and Casper T Schaber, PR consultant and restaurateur. Moderated by Martin Schori, Editor-in-Chief at 08. Free admission. Doors at 5:00 PM, debate at 6:00 PM.

events.title: On Screen@ The Node: SKÅNISH by Akram Mahmod
events.description: SKÅNISH is a double installation featuring footage from online archives and the artist’s family collection of DV tapes. The work consists primarily of material from private family archives, bringing films from different periods into dialogue with one another. Akram Mahmod (b. 1994) is an artist based in Malmö and Stockholm. Through his material, Mahmod explores questions of identity, belonging and representation, rooted in his experience of growing up in Skåne as a first-generation Swede.

events.title: James Cameron – Challenging the Deep
events.description: This temporary exhibition at the Vasa Museum highlights filmmaker, ocean explorer, and technology innovator James Cameron, combining props from his feature films with film projections and rare objects. Visitors can experience Cameron’s greatest underwater endeavors, both real and fictional. The exhibition is produced by the Australian National Maritime Museum in collaboration with the Avatar Alliance Foundation.

events.title: Wilhelm Kåge & Shōji Hamada – Exhibition at Nationalmuseum
events.description: The exhibition at Nationalmuseum, April 23, 2026 – February 28, 2027, presents two ceramic masters united by a love of form, clay, and glaze. Kåge created beautiful everyday design for Gustavsberg, while Hamada spread the Mingei ideals of handcrafted beauty for all.

events.title: Shul! – The Old Town’s synagogue
events.description: At Själagårdsgatan 19, where the Jewish Museum is housed, a synagogue once stood. The synagogue served as a centre of Jewish life in the city and across the country. For nearly a century, from 1795 to 1870, the Jews of Stockholm gathered here to take part in community life and to seek guidance and support from the rabbi. The people who prayed, lived, and worked here were pioneers of Jewish life in Sweden. This exhibition tells their story and the story of their Old Town shul.

events.title: Presentation: Painting the Apocalypse – Art in the Films of Lars von Trier
events.description: Lars von Trier’s films are rich in references to art history, and his visual language often has a distinctly painterly quality. Focusing on what is known as the Depression Trilogy – Antichrist (2009), Melancholia (2011) and Nymphomaniac (2013) – writer and literary critic Sara Abdollahi explores how von Trier uses art to portray depression, melancholy and apocalypse.

events.title: After-Work Event for Archives – Celebrate Arkivens dag with Us
events.description: Join us for an evening exploring memory, power, and digital women’s history, featuring talks, artistic performances and a quiz. What happens to our history when more and more of our lives take place online? Inspired by this year’s theme for Arkivens dag, People and Technology, we will explore how history is created, preserved, and sometimes lost in a digital world. Organised by Kvinnohistoriska, Stockholms läns museum, and the Centrum för fotografi.

events.title: Jazz Session at Haymarket
events.description: Every Thursday from 21.00-23.00, bar Americain fills with the sound of timeless classics and beloved favourites, performed live by our talented jazz band partners. Inspired by the energy of the 1920s, these evenings are all about great music, good company and a touch of old-school charm. Free admission. No booking required. Seating is limited so come early.

events.title: INNER CHILD – Playing with Design
events.description: What happens when we dare to see the world through the curious eyes of a child? Artipelag presents a unique design exhibition exploring the inner child as a source of creativity, hope, and the joy of making. Created exclusively for Artipelag by Lidewij Edelkoort and Philip Fimmano, the exhibition brings together the work of one hundred designers and artists in an inspiring narrative about playfulness, imagination, and the human need to create with our hands.

events.title: Play Beyond Play
events.description: The National Museum of Science and Technology has created an experience where you can not only try your favorite games and explore the game history, but also step into, and let yourself be immersed by, games. The Play Beyond Play exhibition occupies over 1,000 square meters of gaming fun! Join in on a journey through game history!

venue.name: The National Museum of Science and Technology

events.organizer: The National Museum of Science and Technology

events.title: Bybit Stockholm Open 2026
events.description: Stockholm Open was founded in 1969 at the initiative of former world player Sven Davidson. Over a week in October, around 30,000 visitors flock to the Royal Tennis Hall, and the event is made possible by more than 350 volunteers. The tournament is the world’s oldest indoor ATP event and the only one played in an indoor arena specifically built for tennis. Global stars such as Björn Borg, John McEnroe, Roger Federer, Boris Becker, Mats Wilander, and Stefan Edberg have all won the tournament.

events.title: War of the Corsets – Fighting to Shape Femininity at the Turn of the Last Century
events.description: The corset is one of the most controversial garments in the history of fashion. It has been worn for centuries, shaping women's bodies according to the ideals of different times. It came into particular focus at the end of the 19th century. A lively debate flared up in Sweden, which came to be known as the corset war.

events.title: The Swedish Pharmaceutical Society
events.description: This centrally located oasis features a variety of exhibitions on the history of medicines and pharmacies, which you can explore either independently or on a guided tour. The exhibitions include a wealth of informative texts and films that enrich the experience.

events.title: Harder Better Faster Stronger - Are Men Ok?
events.description: What does it mean to be a man today? Is masculinity something we are born with, something we learn, or somethingwe are expected to achieve? Masculinity is currently being debated everywhere, from popular culture and social media to dinner tables and the halls of power. Harder Better Faster Stronger – Are Men OK? is a major group exhibition in which 30 artists from around the world explore one of the most widely debated questions of identity of our time.

events.title: The Wallflowers
events.description: On November 12, The Wallflowers take the stage at Fållan for a unique two-part concert. First, they will perform the entire Bringing Down the Horse album, and after a short break, they return to play the full Long After Dark by Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers. A one-of-a-kind double bill for fans of melodic rock and storytelling songs

events.title: The lady in black
events.description: The play is a Gothic horror production and a story of revenge, love, and grief. The story is set in the mid-19th century. The story follows a young lawyer Arthur Falk who travels north to settle a will from an estate. Once at the house, he notices he is not alone; someone else is there—a lady in black. Are these experiences hallucinations, or are they reality? By Stephen Mallatratt, based on a book by Susan Hill. Directed by Susanna Forsberg. From 13 years.

events.title: Operning and Exhibition with Zaria Zardasht
events.description: The opening is on Friday, October 30th, from 6-8 p.m. in Spånga parish hall. Zaria Zardasht is exhibiting her abstract oil and acrylic paintings. Serving soup and drinks at humane prices. For more information, visit the link below.

events.title: Embraced
events.description: “Embraced” is an exhibition where the viewer not only looks at art, but becomes part of it. Through sculpture, textile, painting, sound, and spatial installations, the body, senses, and presence are activated. Welcome to an immersive art experience featuring contemporary works by Frida Fjellman, Yasmina Karli Malmsten, Sanne Lovén Rolén, and Anna Nyberg.

events.title: K:18 VIN - A wine pop-up in Stockholm with a focus on Systembolagets order assortment
events.description: From November 6–14, K:18 VIN invites wine lovers to explore a curated selection of wines from Systembolaget’s special order assortment at Kungsgatan 18 in central Stockholm. Enjoy a guided tasting of three wines with a sommelier, then relax at the on-site wine bar. Tickets are available via co:labs website, and extra tickets can be bought at the venue. Open to guests aged 20 and over.

events.title: Åmells art exhibition
events.description: Welcome to an art exhibition in Stockholm, held at Åmells Gallery on Birger Jarlsgatan 14. Every year, they display around ten carefully curated presentations of Scandinavian art for sale. Admission is always free, and information about current and upcoming exhibitions is available on Åmells website.

events.title: Old Town Walk
events.description: Join a 1 hour 45 minute historical walk through Stockholm’s Old Town with a guide company based in Gamla stan. The tour connects royal history, architecture, everyday life and details many visitors pass without noticing, from the Royal Palace to the Rose door and the city’s narrowest alley.

events.title: The Machine's Eye in Human Hands
events.description: A photographer fooled an entire world with fabricated images, an artist invites us to interact with an AI agent trained on her own life, childhood, and heartbreak—and in another project, new, uncanny ecosystems are created as archives and algorithms mutate into new species. In The Machine’s Eye in Human Hands at Fotografiska Stockholm, eight artists come together, each diving deeply into AI in contemporary image-making in entirely different ways.

events.title: Yin Yoga & Reiki Healing meets Quantum Healing Technology EESystem
events.description: Gift yourself an evening to slow down, soften and reconnect with yourself in the EESystem Healing Space. Allow your cells to be naturally charged through Scalar-Waves Technology and return to a harmonious and balanced state while enjoying a Yin Yoga class including Reiki Healing.

venue.name: Recharge Haven | Home of EESystem Stockholm

events.organizer: Recharge Haven | Home of EESystem Stockholm

events.title: Dancing Queen
events.description: Some songs belong to a time. Others continue to find new generations. When Dancing Queen was released in 1976, it quickly became a global success. Since then, it has accompanied people through generations – on dance floors, parties, weddings, concerts, and in living rooms around the world.But how was a song created that, even fifty years later, still makes people start dancing?In this exhibition, you will get closer to the story behind Dancing Queen. Through music, objects, images, and stories, you will follow the song’s journey from idea to recording to one of ABBA’s most beloved songs.

events.title: Lotta Antonsson – I Am Everything
events.description: One of Sweden’s leading contemporary photographers, Lotta Antonsson, is coming to Fotografiska with I Am Everything. In this exhibition, the artist explores themes of gender, identity, and objectification within a visual world that both unsettles and beautifies. The exhibition moves fluidly between photography, collage, and spatial installations.

events.title: “Patrizia Cavalli. Che cosa è mio?” by Lorenzo Castore
events.description: The Italian Cultural Institute in Stockholm presents the photo exhibition "Patrizia Cavalli. Che cosa è mio?" by Lorenzo Castore. The exhibition consists of photos taken in the poet Patrizia Cavalli's apartment shortly after her passing. An apartment where she had created her personal universe for over 50 years. From pictures of entire rooms to detailed shots of messy drawers, in every photograph you can feel Cavalli's presence. An intimate portrait of an extraordinary cultural personality.

events.title: Earth & Internet (want to be free) – Interdisciplinary artistic research and the platform landscape
events.description: How can we imagine more just, sustainable and non-extractive digital futures? And how are interdisciplinary artistic research practices pointing to alternative ways to think about critical resources and infrastructures? The keynote presentations is open to the public and will be held at Färgfabriken from 6 to 8 pm. The event is free, but registration is required until November 9th.

events.title: Made in Sweden – The Visual World of Matchbox Labels
events.description: Step into the fascinating visual world of matchbox labels. Based on the unique collection of Otto Lindbohm, this exhibition explores the colourful images that travelled across the globe on Swedish matchboxes, reflecting the ideas, aspirations and values of their time.

events.title: Archipelago Sauna at Skåvsjöholm
events.description: Experience open sauna sessions on the water at Åkersberga, 25 minutes from the city centre. The sauna sits by the jetty looking out over Trälhavet, and it is a short step from bench to water. The sauna is shared with others and sessions run year round, ice or no ice. Bring swimwear and a towel.

events.title: Gamla Stan Walking Tour: Hidden Stories of Stockholm’s Old Town
events.description: Discover Gamla Stan, Stockholm's medieval heart, on a guided walk through alleys and squares where trade, crafts and everyday life once shaped the city. From Slottsbacken to Slussen, hear stories of power, people and hidden corners that bring history to life.

events.title: The Thinking Hand 10 years
events.description: Ten years of the scholarship competition The Thinking Hand has come to an end. A jubilee exhibition will open in October 2026 featuring the artists and scholarship recipients during ten years. This marks the end of the scholarship competition, which was first established to commemorate His Majesty the King’s 70th birthday in 2016. The scholarship competition and exhibition is a collaboration between the Royal Court and the Royal Academy of Fine Arts.

events.title: Gamla Riksarkivet Christmas Dinner 2026
events.description: Gamla Riksarkivet upp sitt vårt hyllade julbord signerat Niklas Ekstedt, i år öppet in i mellandagarna.  På julbordet hittar du ett brett urval av traditionella klassiker, blandat med några nya modernare versioner. Det är även ett generöst utbud av vegetariska alternativ.

events.title: The Factory
events.description: The exhibition "Fabriken" (The Factory) tells the story of nearly 200 years of silk weaving. Built around three themes spanning from the 1800s to today, it is brought to life through the history of K. A. Almgren Silk Weaving Mill. Meet some of the women who worked here, and discover the silk shawls, order ribbons, and gowns they wove and sewed.

venue.name: K. A. Almgren Silk Weaving Mill & Museum

events.organizer: K. A. Almgren Silk Weaving Mill & Museum

events.title: Kurt & Kio (Ages 3–6)
events.description: A playful tribute to imagination, friendship and the magic of everyday life. Kurt and Kio are bored – really bored. The kind of bored where you stare at the ceiling and sigh. But Kio has an idea: a fort! The perfect solution to everything. The only problem is, they don’t have one. Their search for the perfect fort becomes an unexpected adventure – right in the living room. A story about friendship, play, and finding magic in the little things.

events.title: Courage and Action
events.description: Learn about diplomat Per Anger's efforts to rescue Jews during the Second World War, and meet brave human rights defenders who follow in his footsteps. Closed on sundays.

events.title: Beer Tasting Introduction
events.description: A beer tasting where you’ll get to know Omnipollo’s brewery and its most classic beers. We begin with a short tour of the brewery, where we explain the basics of the brewing process and Omnipollo’s philosophy. After the tour, you’ll take part in a guided tasting of four beers from Omnipollo’s classic selection. A perfect first introduction for anyone who wants to learn more about how craft beer is made and how different styles vary in flavour and character. Duration: approx. 1 h 15 min.

events.title: A little corner of Sweden
events.description: The Postal Museum's new exhibition Swedish stamps reflects the country we live in. In recent years alone, you'll find epatraktors, the king, peace symbols, suffrage fighters and many more motifs. Small pictures of Sweden that we then put on our letters, invitations, Christmas cards or small gifts we send to each other. But how are the motifs actually selected? What makes up the picture and how is a stamp designed? You'll find out in the exhibition A Little Corner of Sweden.

events.title: Paddle!
events.description: In The Swedish National Maritime Museum's new exhibition, Paddle!, you can follow the story of paddling – from historical long-distance journeys to today’s outdoor life – and discover why people are continually drawn to the water. The exhibition engages the whole body. Explore different paddling environments, from forest lakes to the open sea, and experience how paddling can offer both adventure and tranquillity.

events.title: Talk: Buttons, Collars & Jackets
events.description: A tram conductor around 1900 stood ramrod straight in a strict, dark uniform with shiny buttons and a high collar. Today you are greeted by a customer host in soft, functional workwear. In this talk we travel through the history of uniforms alongside the history of fashion: how hemlines, cuts, colors and materials have reflected the ideals of their time, from horse-drawn trams to today. In collaboration with the museum's Friends association. Talk, 1 hour. At Spårvägsmuseet, tickets required.

events.title: STOCKHOLM FOOD TOUR
events.description: If you want to get the proper introduction to Sweden, this is the tour for you! Using food as the tool for exploring, we introduce you to what the land of ABBA and VOLVO is all about and take you on an exciting walking tour that highlights the foods that are and have been prolific in making Sweden one of the happiest countries in the world.

events.title: Remnants
events.description: Remnants begins here. What lingers in the archive? What breaths of Black life persist in its folds? What are the aural, visual, and tactile traces that hold both beauty and tension? ​Remnants​ pulls together a poetic constellation of gestures by living and departed artists, where pasts and presents meet in chorus. In the exhibition, we encounter works that resonate with historical memory, resistance, improvisation, and the lived experiences of diaspora and exile.

events.title: Drömlandet – the story of how Sweden became Sweden
events.description: The story of modern Sweden begins with ideas, innovation, and technology. Steelmaking, hydropower, and telephony laid the foundation for industry. Welfare reforms, the contraceptive pill, and parental leave reshaped family life and work. Platforms like Pirate Bay and Spotify transformed the music industry. Follow how a poor agrarian country became a global tech nation – and how the wonders and consequences of technology have shaped society, from politics and trade to culture and everyday life.

events.title: Peter Hägerås – “Album Covers, Watercolors & Flying Saucers”
events.description: The exhibition is diverse and playful. Some works have a specific purpose, while others have no purpose other than the fact that Peter wanted to paint them. Music and visual art have constantly been allowed to blend together. In conjunction with the exhibition, Peter is releasing new music, with some of the paintings once again serving as album covers.Vernissage: Thursday, Oct 29.

events.title: City Faces
events.description: By combining historical photographs, biographical data, and digital facial recognition, Stockholm’s 19th-century faces are brought to life. The exhibition is the result of the project “City Faces”, funded by the Swedish Research Council.

events.title: Guided Winter Kayaking in Stockholm City Centre
events.description: Explore Stockholm from the water on a guided winter kayaking tour right in the city centre. Paddle under bridges and past waterfront buildings, taking in views of the city along the way. A dry suit, safety instructions and all kayaking equipment are included.

events.title: The Sunshine Olympics
events.description: In the museum’s new permanent exhibition, the story of the 1912 Olympic Games in Stockholm is brought to life. The exhibition recreates the festive atmosphere of that summer and invites visitors to try several Olympic disciplines themselves – from diving off a 10 metre platform, pistol shooting with the Carlberg twins, to timing the 100 metre final. Inspired by the architecture of Stockholm Stadium, the exhibition explores what visitors from near and far could experience in Stockholm at the time.

events.title: PolkaBoat
events.description: Be your own captain and discover lake Mälaren from a row boat next to the city hall.

events.title: Nordic Moments
events.description: Nordic Moments at the Nordic Museum highlights photographic collections in an evolving presentation. The opening exhibition Metamorphoses displays negatives rescued from the project 100,000 Photo Memories, where time and chemistry created new visual expressions. On view from October 17, 2025.

events.title: Nordic Life
events.description: Explore life and people in the Nordic region over 500 years, set against its stunning nature, changing seasons and real-life stories from the Nordiska museet collections and archives.The museum’s largest ever exhibition initiative presents 4,000 artefacts and images in an epic and visual presentation of Nordic cultural history built on the real objects and stories collected by the museum during 150 years.

events.title: Kurt och Kio (3-6 år)
events.description: Kurt och Kio har tråkigt. Det finns ingenting att göra. Kio tror att en koja kanske kan lösa problemet. Men var ska de hitta den? I jakten på den perfekta kojan ger de sig ut på ett oväntat äventyr i vardagsrummet. Kurt och Kio är en föreställning om vänskap och lek. Med finurlighet och ett visst mått envishet lyckas de tillsammans skapa en egen magisk värld. Teater Tres Kurt och Kio är baserad på Lisen Adbåges succébok Kurt och Kio vill ha koja, och är en rörelsebaserad föreställning fylld av humor, påhittighet och fantasi. Föreställningen är ca 30 minuter och passar barn 3-6 år. Fritt efter en bok av Lisen Adbåge Regi Hedvig Claesson Medverkande Malin Öhrn & Otto Milde Scenografi & kostym Annika Thore Musik & ljud Otto Milde Dramaturg Maria Clauss Teknik & ljus Anthony Cooks Mask Helena Bernström Producent Lina Karlmark Foto Martin Skoog Turnéproducent: Sara Ulvenstrand Teaterchef: Susanna Humlesjö

events.title: Häpp!
events.description: Häpp! av Lisa Spets & Niklas Valenti Målgrupp: Från 2 år Vila, snurra, sväva och stå. Kul att dansa när man är två. Här är ni, här är vi - Häpp! Med finstämd livemusik och en liten portion magi bjuder Häpp! in till en lekfull stund. Om två vänner och två pallar och den enklaste glädjen i att dansa tillsammans. Med magi, humor och kluriga konster får vännerna pallarna att sväva och snurra. Det är kul att dansa när man är två! Medverkande: Frank Koenen & Martin Östman Musik: Clyde Blomberg Scenografi & kostym: Anna Nyberg Produktion: ZebraDans ”En genomgående vänlig, varm och glad föreställning – som får även en medelålders kritiker att vilja utbrista ”häpp”.” - Anna Ångström SvD

events.title: En bro till förut
events.description: ”En bro till förut” är en fotoutställning av Kemal Gerwise om hans liv som Peshmergasoldat i Kurdistan, det vardagliga mitt i en beväpnad konflikt och omväxlingen att flytta till Sverige efter en krigsskada. Vernissage 31 oktober på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern Vällingby.

events.title: Omfamnad
events.description: "Omfamnad" är en utställning där betraktaren inte bara tittar på konst, utan blir en del av den. Genom skulptur, textil, måleri, ljud och rumsliga installationer aktiveras kropp, sinnen och närvaro. Välkommen till en omslutande konstupplevelse med samtida verk av Frida Fjellman, Yasmina Karli Malmsten, Sanne Lovén Rolén och Anna Nyberg. Visas i Galleri 5 på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern.

events.title: Rum för Minnen
events.description: Mormors kaffekopp, hundens favoritleksak eller din bästa väns handskrivna anteckning. Ett minne kan vara så mycket. "Rum för Minnen" på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern är en rofylld plats dit du kan komma för att tänka på någon som du saknar. Vid utvalda tillfällen arrangeras speciella "minnesceremonier" och med tiden växer en utställning fram i rummet – byggd på besökarnas delade minnen.

events.title: Utblick från anstalten
events.description: Straffen skärps och Kriminalvården expanderar i rekordfart. Men hur är det på insidan av murarna? Under hösten turnerar den mobila utställningen "Utblick från anstalten" till flera platser i Sverige. Installationen presenterar konstverket "Ett torn högre än jag själv" som skapades under hösten 2025 av sex anonyma interner vid Kriminalvårdsanstalten i Kalmar, lett av konstnären Magnus Bärtås.

events.title: Da-da-da
events.description: Titta! Lyssna! Känn! För den allra yngsta publiken – bebisarna! Med inspiration från både huvudfotingar och konstens värld träffar vi figurer i välkända situationer. Som att mötas och skiljas, som att dyka upp och försvinna, som att finnas fast inte synas, som att vara nära och isär, som att vilja ha något man inte får och som att få något man inte vill ha.

events.title: Grevinnan von Petzolds gästabud
events.description: Nils Poletti bjuder in till gästabud efter recept av Gombrowicz: en absurd, rent av grotesk, thriller om en ung man från borgerligheten som med hungrig ambition längtar efter att få ingå i den aristokratiska societeten. Och exklusivare än att bli inbjuden till Grevinnan von Petzolds vegetariska fastemåltid kan det knappast bli. Men vad är det med blomkålen och varför förstår han inte dess smak?

events.title: Jävla karlar
events.description: Jävla karlar är en uppväxtskildring fylld av både mörker och humor. Den handlar om en pojke och hans mamma, om en samling jävla karlar, och om att inte bli en av dem själv.

events.title: pop up shop
events.description:
come along to my first pop-up shop at  Scholes Precinct on Thursday 12th November 11am . 

Have a browse at what I have to offer , lots of different outfit,l and accessories. whether it be for a special occasion or something comfy for your little one. 

I look forward to seeing you all there 😊
events.organizer: Rachel Carrington and Mayva - Ann's Children's Boutique 🎀🎀

events.title: Boktips med bibliotekarierna
events.description: Varje torsdag tipsar Östermalms bibliotekarier om läsning i olika genrer. Litteratur diskuteras högt och lågt. Om du själv läst något bra, ta gärna med ditt eget tips. Biblioteket bjuder på fika. Välkommen. Drop-in!

events.title: Svenska med baby
events.description: Träffarna riktar sig till föräldrar med barn 0-2 år och till seniorer. Vi umgås, fikar, samtalar, sjunger och tränar svenska (för den som vill). Vem vet, kanske hittar du en extra mormor, morfar eller barnbarn på köpet! Det bjuds på fika. Det är gratis och ingen anmälan krävs. Träffarna leds av engagerade föräldralediga volontärer - är du intresserad av att vara gruppledare är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till oss på biblioteket. Välkomna!

events.title: Digital högläsning
events.description: Varje onsdag kl. 16 ses vi på barnavdelningen för en stunds högläsning! Ingen föranmälan behövs. Sagostunden passar barn i åldern 3-6 år men yngre och äldre syskon är såklart också välkomna!

events.title: Pekboksklubb
events.description:
Välkommen till pekboksklubben, en rolig stund på biblioteket för de allra yngsta. Vi utforskar språket genom att sjunga, ramsa och läsa pekbok tillsammans. Kul för både stor och liten. 4-12 månader.

Jämna torsdagar kl. 13-13:30

events.title: Kris, kaos & katastrof
events.description: Måndag morgon i ett klassrum någonstans. Fem elever och en lärare samlas för ett omprov i svenska. I uppgiften ska de svara på frågan “hur ser ditt liv ut om 20 år?”... men vad svarar man när man inte ens vet hur nästa vecka ser ut? Eller måste hantera överbeskyddande morsor och gängkriminella bröder? Kommer fuckboys fortsätta ghosta oss i all framtid? Tänk om livet bara är en AI-genererad evighetsloop? Eller Jesus återvänder? Planeten kanske brinner upp? Snart är eleverna så intrasslade i varandra att de knappt hör inrymningslarmet som tjuter utanför klassrumsdörren... Kris, kaos & katastrof är en sci-fi komedi för alla oss som någon gång känt att världen är på väg att explodera. Skriven av dramatikerstjärnskottet Amar Jašarević, i regi av hyllade Farnaz Arbabi.

events.title: Beri bortom bergen
events.description: Beri bortom bergen handlar om sorgen efter en mammas död, en pappas tid som Peshmerga och om tonårens tvivel över att komma ut. Ett vittnesmål om kamp, sorg och om hur kärleken – om vi vågar hålla fast vid den, kan bli vår starkaste motståndskraft. Av och med Beri Gerwise, i regi av Saga Gärde. Urpremiär på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern Vällingby 30 oktober.

events.title: Släkten Murkelsson
events.description: Släkten Murkelsson är ett nyskrivet historiskt epos som sträcker sig från mitten av 1700-talet till hösten 2026 – i efterskalvet av ett riksdagsval. En brutalt rolig och mörk föreställning om klass, arv och överlevnad, som följer Sverige genom nästan trehundra år. Pjäsen är skriven av Alma Lindé och för regin står Maja Salomonsson.

events.title: Legimusregistrering
events.description: Om du har en funktionsnedsättning som gör det svårt för dig att läsa tryckt text kan du ha rätt till Legimus; ett digitalt bibliotek med talböcker och e-textböcker. Nedanför bokar du tid för att få introduktion och underteckna avtal. Ha med dig giltig legitimation och telefon, surfplatta eller dator. Du kan även komma på drop in, men för att vara säker på att vi har tid och möjlighet att hjälpa dig så erbjuds dessa tider. Är du vårdnadshavare till ett barn som har rätt till Legimus är det bra om båda två kommer. Barnet behöver en giltig e-postadress för att kunna få ett inlogg.

events.title: Bokcirkel i Skärholmen
events.description: Vi träffas var fjärde vecka och diskuterar en bok som vi har läst på förhand. Vi är ett gäng som har läst mycket. Sedan bokcirkeln startade är vi snart uppe i 200 böcker. Vi läser romaner på svenska och bestämmer en ny bok inför varje träff. Välkommen att anmäla dig om du vill vara med!

events.title: Stickcafé
events.description: Välkommen att fika, umgås och slöjda ihop! Vi träffas vid ett bord i caféet. Det är drop-in, så det är bara att kika förbi när du kan. Te, kaffe och fikabröd kan köpas på plats.

events.title: Barnboksklubb på öppna förskolan tema flerspråkighet
events.description:
Välkommen på bibliotekets barnboksklubb på öppna förskolan familjens hus! Adress: Idholmsvägen 79A. Temat för hösten är språk och flerspråkighet. 
Vi har valt ut böcker till träffarna som också finns översatta till olika språk. Högläsningen är på svenska. Böckerna kommer ni också kunna låna hem efter aktiviteterna är slut. Vi kommer också sjunga, rim-och ramsa, pyssla, dramatisera och pyssla tillsammans under terminen. Vi använder tecken som stöd (TAKK) under aktiviteterna. I slutet av terminen får alla deltagare en bokgåva. 
Drop in! Ingen föranmälan behövs. Allt är gratis.

events.title: Shared reading med existentiellt tema
events.description: Shared reading, "delad läsning”, handlar om att tillsammans högläsa olika texter och sedan fritt samtala. Vad väcker orden för insikter, minnen, tankar och känslor? Vi samtalar om livsmening, sorg, glädje, kärlek, vänskap, ensamhet - ja, allt som hör livet till. Inga förkunskaper är nödvändiga. Kom som du är!

events.title: The Politics of Separating Lovers
events.description: Vad händer med kärleken när ett land bestämmer att två människor inte får leva tillsammans?

events.title: Dimitra Konstantinidi – Stockholmskartan
events.description: Under november och december flyttar konstnären Dimitra Konstantinidi in med en tillfällig ateljé i utställningen "Omfamnad" på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern. Här arbetar hon med att skapa en broderad karta över Stockholm, ett nytt verk som utforskar hur en stad kan omfamna sina invånare och hur vi i vår tur omfamnar staden.

events.title: Sångsaga
events.description:
Program för barn 0-2 år och deras vuxna. Fri entré men förbokning krävs.
Vi läser, låter och sjunger en pekbok tillsammans. Avslutas med boktips.

events.description: Program för barn 0-2 år och deras vuxna. Vi läser, låter och sjunger en pekbok tillsammans. Avslutas med boktips! Programmet är cirka 20 minuter långt.

venue.address: Sergels torg, Bibliotek Rum för barn

events.title: Häng på Bibblan
events.description:
Kom som du är – alla kan vara med! Spela spel, läs en bok eller skapa i vårt gemensamma projekt.
Drop-in.

events.title: Språkcafé på engelska
events.description:
Välkommen och träna din engelska tillsammans med våra duktiga volontärer och övriga deltagare!
ANMÄLAN VIA LÄNK

events.title: Makerspace för 10-12 år
events.description: Under makerspace är vi i ateljén och utforskar tillsammans ny teknik, experimenterar och skapar. Ingen föranmälan.

events.title: Vi läser Balladen om Marie Krøyer
events.description:
Välkommen till en bokcirkel med havet som tema, där vi under hösten fördjupar oss i litteratur och konst med havet i centrum. Vi träffas torsdagarna den 29/10, 12/11 samt 3/12 . Bokcirkeln avslutas i januari 2027 med en guidad visning av utställningen Till havet på Nationalmuseum.

Under hösten läser vi Balladen om Marie Krøyer av den danska författaren och forskaren Anastassia (Tonni) Arnold. Boken gavs ut på svenska för första gången år 2000 och ligger till grund för regissören Bille Augusts välkända film.

events.title: Svenskt språkcafé på ryska
events.description: Språkcafé för dig som kan ryska och vill lära dig svenska. Ingen anmälan behövs.
